###deimos_expertmode
# @name: Grab rug under soil
# @zone: Housing
# @author: generated by tools/gen_garden_bot.py
# @format: expertmode
# @description: Clicks points on the rug rim until the Golden Blossom Rug is selected, then opens advanced move.
#
# SETUP: housing mode (H bar visible), soil on the rug, nothing selected, rug in view.

block wait_world {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
        log '[G] ERROR: WorldView not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_bottom {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'ObjectPlacementWindow', 'ObjectPlacementBottom', 'ObjectPlacementSubWindow', 'BottomFrame'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'ObjectPlacementWindow', 'ObjectPlacementBottom', 'ObjectPlacementSubWindow', 'BottomFrame'] {
        log '[G] ERROR: housing placement bar (press H first) not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_adv {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
        log '[G] ERROR: AdvancedMoveObjectButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_accept {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton'] {
        log '[G] ERROR: advanced movement AcceptButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block grabbed {
    log '[G] SUCCESS: rug selected, opening advanced move'
    call wait_adv
    mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton']
    sleep 0.6
    call wait_accept
    log '[G] advanced movement is open on the rug - accepting without moving'
    mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton']
    sleep 0.6
    kill
}
log '[G] === Grab rug under soil ==='

call wait_bottom
